overview.title: Account Overview
overview.subtitle: Manage your security settings, active sessions, and linked accounts.

security.enable_2fa_message: Your account is less secure without Multi-Factor Authentication. Enable it now to protect your data.

account.update_profile_subtitle: Manage your personal details, preferences, and notification settings.

avatar_customization.title: Avatar Customization
avatar_customization.drop_image: Drop an image here or click to upload

account.biography_placeholder: Tell us a little about yourself...
account.email_notifications_desc: Receive email updates about comments on your posts.
account.reply_notifications_desc: Get notified when someone replies to your comments.
account.achievement_notifications_desc: Be informed when you unlock new achievements.
account.new_device_alerts_desc: Receive an alert whenever a new device signs into your account.
account.watchlist_notifications_desc: Get updates on items you are watching.
account.mention_notifications_desc: Be notified when someone mentions you.
account.linked_accounts_desc: Manage your connected experiences across services.
account.revoke_warning: Revoking access will prevent you from logging in with {{provider}} and stop any active data sync.
account.link_description: Linking this account allows you to securely sign in using {{provider}} via Single Sign-On (SSO).
account.export_data_desc_detailed: Request a complete archive of your personal information, including profile details, login history, and preferences. We will prepare a JSON file for you.
account.export_requested_message: Your data archive is being prepared. You will receive an email when it is ready.
account.export_failed: Failed to initiate data export. Please try again later.
account.delete_account_desc_detailed: Permanently erase your account and all associated data from our systems. This action is irreversible according to GDPR 'Right to be Forgotten'.
account.delete_account_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This will permanently erase your profile, settings, and all associated data.
account.delete_account_warning: Warning: This action cannot be undone. You will lose access to all services immediately.
account.enter_password_to_delete: Enter your password to confirm deletion
account.erasure_started_message: Your account erasure request has been received and is being processed.
account.erasure_failed: Failed to process erasure request. Please verify your password.
